title: Benghuai: Xing Qiong Tiedao - Na Anxi de Changye

alternative_titles.en: Honkai: Star Rail - The Long Night of Serenity
alternative_titles.ja: 《崩坏：星穹铁道》动画短片：「那安息的长夜」

synopsis:
Don the crown that halts life
Even death itself favors lowered eyes
Walk through the palace of farewells
Connect to the world of the departed

Amid the icy depths and funeral hymns
Days and nights
Bow over this snow-covered land
Become the only song here

All sighs flow from her fingertips
All words of comfort are stopped by her hands
All cries of grief are swallowed by her palms

A poem titled "Aidonia's Holy Maiden"

(Source: Official YouTube Channel)
